collegeInfo: SCMHRD Pune is a top B-School under Symbiosis International University, with a reputation for leadership in HR, Business Analytics, Operations, Finance, and Marketing domains. It consistently ranks among India’s best for management education, placements, and corporate involvement. Its diverse academic environment and strong industry interface set it apart.

scholarships.eligibilityCriteria: Awarded on the basis of merit (top rankers of first semester and/or socioeconomic background per Symbiosis norms).
scholarships.applicationProcess: Automatic or via institute/centralized portal as notified.

events.eventFullDescription: NEEV is SCMHRD’s celebrated annual B-school extravaganza. With over 35,000 participants from premier institutions nationwide, the fest includes business games, management competitions, cultural galas, and corporate conclaves.

The HR Summit hosts top HR leaders and practitioners from diverse industries. The event consists of panel discussions, keynote speeches, and workshops—bridging theory and HR practice for future managers.

collegeName: Symbiosis Centre for Management & Human Resource Development

infrastructure.infraDescription:
SCMHRD Pune offers a modern, fully Wi-Fi enabled campus in Hinjawadi, Pune, with contemporary lecture halls, analytics and finance labs, academic and recreation spaces. Hostel facilities, sports grounds, a medical centre, dining, and gymnasium provide a vibrant campus experience.

Academic Infrastructure:

  • Smart AV classrooms, dedicated learning spaces, analytics and computer labs.

Residential Facilities:

  • Hostels for men and women, mess, health clinic.

Recreation & Amenities:

  • Sports complex, gymnasium, cafeterias, and career support center.
